notes.title: Impasse Journey": A Post-Apocalyptic Tale in Taiwan, Launching on Steam
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8336155/a80a3bee7f34c2291d4f1001749b806b3b5fdf93.png[/img]

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2464330/_/]"Impasse Journey" Steam[/url][/b]

"Impasse Journey", This visual novel, set in a post-apocalyptic Taiwan, is poised for its debut on the Steam platform.

In "Impasse Journey", the storyline unfolds in the year 20XX, against the backdrop of a sudden Taiwan Strait conflict that plunged the world into an apocalyptic chaos. Fast forward 30 years, and Taiwan has morphed into a mosaic of self-governing regions, each striving to forge a new existence amidst the remnants of the old world.

Players will immerse themselves in the role of Yang Qiongqi, a reticent yet emotionally complex protagonist, on a quest to fulfill a promise and discover the truth. The journey begins in Kaohsiung, where players are thrust into a brewing conflict between local vigilantes and the government forces, with each decision shaping the narrative's course.

"Impasse Journey" is rich in narrative, offering over 300,000 words of engrossing storyline that delve into the background and motives of each character. Beyond Yang Qiongqi, players will encounter a diverse cast, including Huang Shihan, a young woman driven by ideals to join the vigilantes, Xiao Ziqin, a war-orphaned girl with impressive leadership skills, and Wu Yating, a dreamer from the underbelly of Kaohsiung.

The game stands out for its intricate depiction of post-war life in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, exploring themes of survival and rebirth. Through a multitude of choices, players will navigate a narrative intertwined with the daily struggles and overarching storyline of a world rebuilt from ruins.

"Impasse Journey" is set to offer a unique gaming experience, as players search for hope and meaning in a world that has known immense destruction. With its imminent release on Steam, the game promises a memorable foray into a world of survival and discovery.

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2464330/_/]"Impasse Journey" Steam[/url][/b]

notes.title: "The Leopard Catgirl in Miaoli" will release in october 20th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11008272/c1c2be57b04ef5b9902d765f47e401fafb0d0dc6.png[/img]

[url=The Leopard Catgirl in Miaoli]https://reurl.cc/e5314M[/url]

[b]Story[/b]
In the year 201X, Hualian county held a mockery of a referendum to become the Kingdom of Hualian. After the Kingdom of Hualian is established, it had a domino effect where all 22 counties in Taiwan held a similar referendum. Surprisingly, all of them were successful, leading to chaos in Taiwan.

The protagonist Wang Cheng-En was a pharmacist who worked in Taipei. When he was barred from working there, he returned to his hometown Miaoli Empire. Along the way, he didn't expect to come across a wounded leopard catgirl Pisuka Riya. By taking care of her, a story on the romance between the two of them in Miaoli Empire begins.

[b]Game Features[/b]
1.Stander virtual novel play style.2.With saving and loading feature.
3.Support three different languages.
4.Contain many original musics and songs.

notes.title: Our new game -Blue Blood Lagoon- are now on Greenlight
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/dgubaPx.png[/img]
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=701653272

“Blue Blood Lagoon”, a story about youth and romance during the Chinese Civil War, is another tremendous effort by Erotes Studio, the developer of “Rainy Port Keelung” and “MayJasmine.”

[h1]We always thought we had a choice.[/h1] 
[h1]We could escape from the cage and go wherever we like.[/h1]
[h1]Eventually we discovered that the sky and the earth were just a bigger cage.[/h1]
[h1]We never did have any choice.[/h1]
[h1]Goodbye, seventeen forever.[/h1]
[h1]On July 13, we graduated.[/h1]

[h1][b]We are nothing, and we will not be remembered.[/b][/h1]

[h1]Story:[/h1]
In 1949, The Chinese Civil War rages on.
To escape the war, students from Shandong led by their teachers began making their way to the islands of Penghu, a distant and unfamilar land our in the sea.

The hero of the story, Yin Hsiao-Feng, came from an insular and traditional family, so he has always kept his feelings tightly locked away.
He is now all alone after becoming separated from his family and joining the refugees fleeing the Civil War.

During the flight to safety however, Hsiao-Feng meet the two most important people in his life:

Teng Lin, a charming and innocent young girl who believes that the Civic War would soon end in peace, no matter who the winner is.
Sun Yi-Fang, a cheerful and forthright beauty, who still believes that the tide of war will soon be turned, and triumph will eventually arrive.

His everyday school life with the two girls gradually heals Hsiao-Feng’s wounded soul and a story of youthful romance unfolds between the three of them.

[h1]Game Type:[/h1]
School Romance AVG

[h1]Game Features:[/h1]
[*]Full-length AVG with multiple story-lines and endings.
[*]Native Full HD graphics. Meet and interact with beautiful young girls in high-definition quality.
[*]All dialog dubbed in Mandarin by top voice actors such as Chien Hsin-Yu, Shih Cai-Wei, and Lin Mei-Siou.
[*]Over 40 sets of exquisite CG.
[*]The player’s choices will decide the fate of the characters with up to ten possible endings.
[*]11 main characters, 1 hidden character and 15 sets of character portraits.
[*]20 original BGM tracks.
[*]1 title song, 3 interlude songs, 6 ending songs - a total of 10 song tracks.
[*]Steam achievements, wallpapers, cards, and emoticons are all available.

notes.title: The motivation to the creation of Mayjasmine.
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/ZPorVBI.png[/img]

A short digression: Ever since Mayjasmine's release on December, we've received tons of feedback, both negative and positive. We are sincerely grateful for such wonderful opinions, for they are the key to our team's improvement. As for the issue of translation... yes, we will definitly go work on that.

As for the motivation: On May, 2014, there was a huge anti-Chinese protest in Vietnam. In 1998, similar events happened, and its scale was, if not the same, even worse than the Vietnam protest. This event reminded us several dark memories and, due to our private reasons, we decided to choose the events of May, 1998 as our topic for our next game.

During the investigation and data analysis process, our team was surrounded by a pressing atmosphere. Not only is the event itself having a dark nature, but the cruelty and bloodiness of the historical materials only worsens our case. Moreover, this event resembles a kaleidoscope: everyone sees the event from different perspectives, yet claims their own perspective to be the whole. This is essentially why such events keep repeating themselves. Despite all that, however, it was our team's faith, reflected upon in Mayjasmine, that supported us: to end the persecution, to strive for peace between different races, to work for gender equity, and to support the freedom of sexual orientation.

So many have perished, yet what lessons do they bring upon the living? Has the disclosure of these bloody material become forbidden, buried in the earth of history, never to be mentioned ever again?

We hope to try our best to express our belief that persecution of any form, for any reason, ought not to exist. This includes but is not limited to internation persecution, but also the more relevant religioun persecution, sexual orientation persecution, and sexual persecution. Even now, as this post is being read, there are countless persecutions happening everywhere, known or unbeknownst. Peace and self-evaluation, or the eternal hatred, these are what us, the living people, should take time to contemplate.

When those that have perished have become a stastical data on reports, perhaps all we would do is type R.I.P., then discard them from our memories. But when they've become characters starring in a play representing their thoughts and expressions, we believe that something ought to be understood. Those lost souls, injured flesh, innocent dreams, and love themselves.

It's less than 3 years until the 20th anniversary of the 1998 event. We hope that Mayjasmine could help shed light on this dark history, to encourage more thoughts on historical events and lessons. History can be forgiven, but never forgotten.
